question: Oda-sensei, hello!! In Volume 38, you wrote "When you don't know the answer on a test, just write instrumental", so I tried that myself. But when I got the test back, it was checked wrong. Why was it checked wrong? Please tell me why. Four!!
answer: The results are not the point. The real treasure here is your courage, for taking the first step forward. (←?)
name: Katsufumi Four
